text: "Fortune is the arbiter of one-half of our actions."
But she leaves the other half, or a little less, for us to steer.
He compared her to a raging river. In flood, it sweeps away trees and buildings.
Nobody can stop it then. But in calm weather, people can build defenses and barriers.
Fortune shows her power where no one has prepared to resist her.
So in the good times, don't coast. Save money. Learn a skill. Build trust.
